title: Laptop
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">

  <rect x="40" y="68" width="20" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8fa0bb"/>
  <!-- glow light on lid edge -->
  <rect x="22" y="55" width="56" height="2" rx="1" fill="#7fe9ff" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
